mapper.select: SELECT item.*, t3.`name` as processName, batch.product_name, batch.product_name, batch.product_merge_code, batch.product_specification, batch.reuse_batch_number, item.group_number, item.procedure_list as procedureListItem, item.related_batch_info FROM bm_production_plan_item AS item JOIN bm_plan_template_batch AS batch ON item.template_batch_id = batch.id join bm_process as t3 on t3.id = batch.process_id WHERE item.is_deleted = 0 and item.production_plan_id =#{productionPlanId}

select t1.id as productionPlanItemId, t1.start_time as productDate, t1.plan_no, t1.batch_no, t1.process_num, t2.product_id, t2.product_name, t2.product_merge_code, t2.product_specification, t2.inner_packing_specification, t2.packing_specification, t1.production_line_id, t1.production_line_code, t2.product_mark, t1.batch_quantity, t2.unit_id, t2.process_id, t2.process_name, t2.process_version, t3.production_stage_code from bm_production_plan_item t1 left join bm_plan_template_batch t2 on t1.template_batch_id = t2.id left join bm_process_version t3 on (t2.process_id = t3.process_id and t2.process_version = t3.version) where t2.is_deleted = 0 and t1.is_deleted = 0 and t1.id in
#{id}

SELECT t2.id as planItemId, t3.procedure_config, t2.procedure_list FROM bm_production_plan_item AS t2 JOIN bm_plan_template_batch AS t3 ON t2.template_batch_id = t3.id WHERE t2.is_deleted = 0 and t2.id in
#{id}
